title: Upstream remaining openmls fork commits; retire superseded ones
description:
Goal (Mark 2026-10-22): shrink the MarkAtwood/openmls fork mimid patches in, and build an openmls maintainer track record. Fork rev a36719847c81 = v0.9.1 + 5 commits. Mapping as of 2026-10-22:
- 5abd9e08 'classify GREASE KeyPackage extensions as Grease': superseded by upstream #2162 (merged main 2026-09-21; not in 0.9.2). Drop when mimid moves to the first release containing it.
- d052e729 'optional PublicGroup lifetime check' and 6968f3f1 'MlsGroup leaf lifetime policy setter': superseded by upstream #2257 (mtrossbach, merged 2026-10-19), which passes LeafNodeLifetimePolicy per call (VerifyAt, process_message_with_lifetime_policy, PublicGroup::from_external_with_lifetime_policy, builder leaf_node_lifetime_policy). mimid must port its call sites to that API when it moves to that release.
- 24f3eb65 'external AppDataUpdate proposals': Mark's open upstream PR #2292.
- a3671984 'authenticated_data on external AppDataUpdate' (draft-ietf-mls-extensions-10 §4.9): NOT upstream. Either fold into #2292 (it builds on it) or open a follow-up PR after #2292 merges.
Also open upstream, not in the fork: #2286 (AppDataUpdate list rules without GCE proposal), #2293 (component operation base_label 'MLS Component').
Work: keep #2286/#2292/#2293 rebased and answer review; prepare the a3671984 PR; when the next openmls release lands, rebase the fork to only the still-unmerged commits (ideally zero) and port to the #2257 API. Every upstream write (PR, push to an upstream-facing branch, comment) needs Mark's explicit go. Related: mimid-qcja (rebase onto v0.9.2 for the security advisories).
notes: 2026-11-04: upstream PR openmls/openmls#2317 (branch MarkAtwood:fix/keypackage-consumed-on-join, commit af00198c9, on origin/main 28369d5b4) fixes #2316. Unifies with upstream's VC deferral. When it merges, the fork commit 21c9dcce8 is superseded on rebase (.4.69).
